objective_text: Identify and retrieve explicit information and ideas from a reading passage.
Infer meaning and explain what a text suggests, supporting the answer with evidence.
Analyse how a writer uses language and structure to create effects on the reader.
Compare the ideas, attitudes and perspectives presented in two texts.
Select relevant points and write a concise summary in your own words.
Identify the audience, purpose and required form of a directed writing task.
Apply the conventions of a specified text type, such as a letter, article, speech, review or journal entry.
Select and evaluate material from a reading passage to develop a convincing response.
Use a register, tone and structure appropriate to the audience and purpose.
Write with accurate spelling, punctuation and grammar in directed writing.
Structure a narrative with an effective opening, development and resolution.
Use sensory description and details of setting to create atmosphere.
Plan and organise a composition into cohesive, well-linked paragraphs.
Use precise vocabulary, imagery and figurative language for effect.
Vary sentence structure and use punctuation accurately to control pace and emphasis.
